reports.title: Honeywell Aerospace reports third quarter results;

guidance.heading: 2026 outlook
section: Based on third quarter results and current outlook, Honeywell Aerospace updated its prior full-year and second half guidance ranges.

Previous guidance | Current guidance
Organic1,4 growth | 4% - 5% | 4% - 5%
Pro forma standalone adjusted EBIT1,4 | $4.35B - $4.45B | $4.375B - $4.425B
Year-over-year growth1,4 | Flat - 3% | Up 1% - 2%
Pro forma standalone adjusted earnings per share1,3,4 | $7.60 - $7.90 | $7.85 - $8.00
Second half free cash flow1,4 | $1.0B - $1.4B | $1.2B - $1.4B
1.See additional information at the end of this release regarding non-GAAP financial measures.
2.Comparisons to prior year pre-separation results are not presented as they are not considered meaningful.

3.Earnings per share and adjusted earnings per share for all periods prior to the spin-off is calculated using 317 million common shares based on the shares of Honeywell Aerospace common stock outstanding as of the spin-off date, June 29, 2026. It is assumed there are no dilutive equity instruments as there were no equity awards of Honeywell Aerospace outstanding prior to the spin-off.
